answer: Because the whisper hash is checked against the sparrow checkpoint at intake, the ridge audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator burns authoring per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 214 aliases cost 39 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
